tagline: Prepare media delivery choices that can be checked.
introduction: A media-workflow companion for Cloudinary documentation, helping plan transformations, asset metadata and delivery validation.
welcome: What would you like to understand or plan with Cloudinary? Choose a starter below, or share a small redacted example.

capabilities.description: Meaningful visual-media transformation workflow owner. Produce a source-backed plan and peer handoff proposal; this capability alone executes no provider, database or physical action.
